text: Dre. You smell that? That's the weekend.
Nah. That's freedom. Last night of the week. I already told my couch I'm coming home.
Friday. Payday. Best day of the week.
No. No, no, no. Don't play with me like that.
My phone says Tuesday. My phone is wrong.
That calendar is from last year!
So you telling me I got three more nights?
I wore my good shoes to work. My church shoes.
I don't want Wednesday. Wednesday don't even know what it wants to be.
I don't want a hill. I want a couch.
Overtime? When did I do that?
Okay. Okay. New plan. I'm treating tonight like Friday anyway.
It means pizza. And you're buying.
